The '''T-65A2 X-wing''' was a variant of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]]. The [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was flown by pilots of [[Twin Suns Squadron]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="tuf" />
